description: RTAA* (Real-Time Adaptive A*) is a real-time search with the same lookahead and moves as LSS-LRTA*: A* from the agent's state for at most `n` expansions, then a move toward the best open state. Its learning step is cheaper. With `f` the `g + h` of the state where A* stopped, each expanded state `s` gets the value `f − g(s)`, with no second search. These values are lower than or equal to those of LSS-LRTA*, so it learns less per step but each step costs less. From an admissible table the values stay admissible.

papers.title: Real-time adaptive A*
papers.venue: Proceedings of the Fifth International Joint Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS)
